hints.title: Examination Sequence
hints.text: Partition by student and subject and rank exam dates chronologically.

hints.title: Score Extraction
hints.text: Identify the earliest and latest scores using ascending and descending date rankings.

hints.title: Strict Improvement Check
hints.text: Filter pairs with at least two exams where latest_score strictly exceeds first_score, ordered by student_id and subject.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RankedScores AS (
    SELECT 
        student_id, 
        subject, 
        score, 
        exam_date,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, subject ORDER BY exam_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, subject ORDER BY exam_date DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM Scores
),
FirstLastScores AS (
    SELECT 
        student_id, 
        subject, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN score END) AS first_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN score END) AS latest_score
    FROM RankedScores
    GROUP BY student_id, subject
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    student_id, 
    subject, 
    first_score, 
    latest_score
FROM FirstLastScores
WHERE latest_score > first_score
ORDER BY student_id ASC, subject ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Window ranking partition and aggregation over student scores.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining full date cartesian products degrades performance needlessly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses window ranking to extract boundary exam scores per partition.
